name: Krannert Building

source_evidence_added.provider: Indiana Architect / Indiana Society of Architects
source_evidence_added.title: Indiana Architect, October 1965, selected-for-exhibition project page
source_evidence_added.project_caption: Krannert Building, Purdue, West Lafayette; architect Walter Scholer & Associates; general contractor K. H. Kettlehut.
visible_original_design_cues: repeated narrow vertical dark glazing set in broad light-colored piers
substantial dark/recessed ground-floor band and entry canopy/colonnade
flat roofline with a louver-like screened zone at the roof edge
low reflecting pool/landscape in the 1965 site view
source_evidence_added.limits: A historical perspective photograph, not a measured elevation, dimensioned drawing, current-condition source, color-calibrated image, or evidence for hidden/courtyard elevations. It cannot independently validate roof/equipment height, GIS registration, or exact facade module dimensions. The 1965 reflecting pool is not modeled in the building library and is not claimed to be current.

comparison_method: Side-by-side qualitative visual comparison of the 1965 archival facade photo and reopened R4 south/front render. No pixel registration, scale inference, perspective correction or measured feature extraction performed.

grade_findings_remaining: No independent footprint/orientation proof; master marker matching manifest does not establish shell-to-GIS fit.
Building height, floor elevations, roof and penthouse remain weakly supported; GIS vertical attribute units are undocumented.
Current facade cadence and courtyard geometry still require stronger evidence.
review_context.response: Searched for original design documentation and added this contemporary 1965 architectural-journal image. No volume or opening edits were made because the image is perspective-distorted, historical, and does not resolve current/courtyard geometry or dimensioned cadence.

coordinator_note: Master manifest still lists KRAN_Surrounding_Plaza_Paving, removed from the source in R3. The coordinator alone should reconcile the shared manifest inventory before integration.
